test_strategy: Adopt a layered testing approach targeting Node.js/Express APIs, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB integrations. Use Jest for unit and integration testing, Postman/Newman for API E2E validation, and custom Python scripts for data validation and parity checks. Load testing performed with k6 or Artillery to confirm <50ms read latency (p95). Implement CDC reliability tests via simulated high-write traffic and monitor lag thresholds under CloudWatch. Security and rollback tests cover encryption and failover scenarios. Automated CI/CD integration through GitHub Actions executes test suites before rollout toggles.

test_cases.title: Validate MongoDB schema flexibility for country-specific fields
test_cases.description: Ensure MongoDB schema correctly stores and retrieves country-specific regulatory data fields
steps: Insert customer record with jp_myNumber field
Insert another customer record with eu_vatId field
Retrieve both records
test_cases.expected_result: Schema accepts different country fields without failure or affecting other documents

test_cases.title: CDC pipeline synchronization from PostgreSQL to MongoDB
test_cases.description: Verify CDC backfill process captures inserts/updates/deletes from PostgreSQL into MongoDB
preconditions: AWS DMS or Debezium connector configured
steps: Perform insert, update, delete operations on PostgreSQL customers table
Monitor MongoDB collection and CDC logs
Validate data parity after each operation
test_cases.expected_result: All CDC changes reflected in MongoDB with zero data loss and latency <2s

test_cases.title: Dual-write API consistency test
test_cases.description: Test API writes to ensure records are successfully stored in both PostgreSQL and MongoDB during dual-write phase
steps: POST /api/customers with valid data
Verify record in PostgreSQL and MongoDB
Disable PostgreSQL temporarily to simulate failure and check retry logic
test_cases.expected_result: Writes committed to both databases or retried successfully on temporary failure

test_cases.title: Feature flag rollout for MongoDB reads
test_cases.description: Validate that toggling feature flag switches read source dynamically without downtime
steps: Enable useMongoReads flag
Call GET /api/customers/:id and confirm source is MongoDB
Disable flag and confirm source reverts to PostgreSQL
test_cases.expected_result: Reads toggle seamlessly between data sources with no downtime or cache errors

test_cases.title: Data parity validation before cutover
test_cases.description: Check data integrity between PostgreSQL and MongoDB using validation service
steps: Run parity validation script
Call /api/migration/validation/status endpoint
Review discrepancies count
test_cases.expected_result: Validation reports 0 discrepancies and full record parity confirmed

test_cases.title: Rollback procedure test within 1 hour window
test_cases.description: Ensure rollback process can revert API reads/writes to PostgreSQL while disabling CDC
steps: Trigger POST /api/admin/rollback with confirmRollback=true
Monitor rollback logs and API responses
Verify all subsequent reads/writes directed to PostgreSQL
test_cases.expected_result: Rollback completes within 60 minutes, data integrity preserved, CDC disabled

test_cases.title: MongoDB index performance under load
test_cases.description: Validate that MongoDB queries meet latency targets under simulated traffic
steps: Run 5,000 read/second across common query patterns
Collect p95 latency metrics
Review CPU and memory utilization
test_cases.expected_result: Average read latency <50ms (p95) with no degradation in throughput

test_cases.title: Security check for field-level encryption and secure connections
test_cases.description: Ensure that sensitive fields are encrypted and all connections use TLS
steps: Insert record with sensitive fields (My Number, VAT ID)
Inspect stored document and verify encryption
Confirm TLS handshake in connection logs
test_cases.expected_result: Sensitive data encrypted, TLS in use for both PostgreSQL and MongoDB traffic

test_cases.title: Edge case test - NULL and missing fields migration
test_cases.description: Validate migration handles NULLs and missing country fields correctly
steps: Run CDC and validate records with NULL fields
Query migrated documents in MongoDB
Validate structure integrity and absence of unwanted fields
test_cases.expected_result: Migration handles missing fields gracefully with valid document structure

test_cases.title: High concurrency test for Dual-write mechanism
test_cases.description: Simulate parallel writes during heavy traffic to validate transactional integrity
steps: Execute 200 concurrent POST /api/customers requests
Check PostgreSQL and MongoDB consistency post-run
Monitor retry and error logs
test_cases.expected_result: All transactions succeed or retry; no record inconsistency or data loss

test_data_requirements: Sample customer dataset including country variations (US, JP, EU)
Subset of PostgreSQL records with NULL values
Load generation scripts for 2M customer records parity check
Encrypted field samples for VAT ID and My Number
automation_approach: Leverage Jest for API and service-level unit/integration tests within CI/CD pipeline. Use Postman collections executed by Newman for E2E API regression checks across PostgreSQL and MongoDB sources. Implement automated parity validator scripts via Python using nightly jobs. Integrate performance tests using k6 or Artillery with AWS CloudWatch dashboards for latency monitoring. Security validation automated with MongoDB client inspection and TLS certificate verification scripts. All tests triggered on feature-flag deployment events to ensure rollouts are safe and verifiable.
coverage_goals: 90% backend service code coverage (Unit + Integration), 100% API endpoints covered by E2E tests, 100% data parity achieved before migration cutover, <50ms p95 read latency validated, rollback procedure verified in both staging and production environments.
